justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/CachingMatcher.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ElementMatchers.java, and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/CachingMatcherTest.java. WithInlineEviction is a small nested class with only one field (evictionSize), one constructor, and one overridden method that adds a single eviction check before delegating to the base cache-miss logic; the parent CachingMatcher itself is also compact (constructor, matches, onCacheMiss, toString). The tests exercise only caching and inline eviction behavior, indicating a focused single responsibility rather than a class that needs further decomposition.
